title: 750 moves, none confirmed
headline: 750 moves, none with a checked sale. Here is what that costs.
dek: Since Sep 28 the board has published 750 mover rows over 44 mornings, 360 on the 7-day list and 390 on the since-yesterday list. Every one is labeled Unconfirmed: no sale was checked behind it. Checked sales did start appearing on the board on Nov 3, but for a short list of tracked cards, and none of them is a card the lists show moving. We show these moves anyway, because a price reading is information, and we say what it isn't.
why_now: Every File so far has put "unconfirmed" on every row. The board's sales source now has a date (sales as of Nov 8) and its flags file has a flagged sale, so this is the week to say plainly what the label means, what showing these moves costs, and what would change it.
risk: Showing a move with no sale behind it can read as a claim. The rules limit that: a move over 60% in a week, or over 40% in a day, is left out unless a checked sale speaks to it. That is also why a real one-reading halving never shows on the since-yesterday list, as Thursday's File found. "Unconfirmed" is a statement about our checking, not about the card. This is not a read on whether any of these prices is high or low.
what_to_watch: The first mover row that reads anything but Unconfirmed: it would mean a checked sale landed on a card the list shows, and its label would say what kind. The flags file: its one flagged sale this week is a thin spike on a Charizard SIR (151) PSA 9, a claimed +27.1% "above recent sales, thin volume". And whether the tracked list grows to cover the cards the lists show.
source: TCGplayer market prices via tcgcsv.com, from the board's published lists, Sep 28 to Nov 10, 2026 (44 mornings); the board's meta.json and flags.json as of Nov 8, 2026

foot: Market price: TCGplayer's average of recent completed sales of the same card, condition and printing (help.tcgplayer.com). The counts: the board's own published movers lists, Sep 28 to Nov 10, 2026, 44 mornings (git history of data/movers.json): 360 rows in the 7-day list and 390 in the since-yesterday list, every one labeled UNCONFIRMED (the since-yesterday list began Oct 3). The table: five of the Nov 10 list's ten moves (prices Nov 2 to Nov 9; the change between 3-day medians at each end; start-of-week prices worked back from the listed price and its rounded change, so within a dollar). The list: up to 10 Pokémon cards worth $20 or more that moved 5% or more in a week; with no checked sales, a move shows only if it's 60% or less, the lowest listing moved the same way by at least a quarter as much, the price changed in the last 2 days, and the card trades. The since-yesterday list: 3% or more, 40% or less without a checked sale. Unconfirmed: no sale checked by Mission Control's Sale Integrity Layer in that window. Not advice.
